* '''Playtest''' (this page, 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-invisiblehandobservatoryentrance-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/invisiblehandobservatoryentrance.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “If your [Clone Army] character here, your characters are defense value +1 here.” Dark Side: “While Insidious Prisoner here, your characters are power +1 here.” The title strips print “•NVISIBLE HAND: OBSERVATORY ENTRANCE”.
* '''Original''' ([[Invisible Hand: Observatory Entrance]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-invisiblehandobservatoryentrance-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/invisiblehandobservatoryentrance.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “While your [Clone Army] character here, your characters are defense value +1 here.” Dark Side: “While Insidious Prisoner here, your characters are power +1 here.” '''What changed:''' before release: both title strips' misprint “•NVISIBLE HAND: OBSERVATORY ENTRANCE” became “•INVISIBLE HAND: OBSERVATORY ENTRANCE”; Light Side “If your [Clone Army] character here” became “While your [Clone Army] character here”; the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; re-rendered with sharper graphics.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Invisible Hand: Observatory Entrance (Errata)]], 2 August 2019): Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-invisiblehandobservatoryentrance-20190802-d24ffc3.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/invisiblehandobservatoryentrance.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “While your [Clone Army] character here, your characters are defense value +1 here.” Dark Side: “While Insidious Prisoner here, your characters are power +1 here.” '''What changed:''' the image was re-uploaded on release day turned 90° (stored as a landscape site card, Holotable commit “Flipped sites”); same picture and words. Listed as its own version under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 (18:48: every published image that differs from the previous one is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Invisible Hand: Observatory Entrance (Errata 2)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-invisiblehandobservatoryentrance.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/invisiblehandobservatoryentrance.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “While your [Clone Army] character here, your characters are defense value +1 here.” Dark Side: “While Insidious Prisoner here, your characters are power +1 here.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
